pedagogical_depth.justification: Every lesson includes a full expanded_walkthrough naming a specific Grade-1 trap (all-possible default, silly-not-impossible, perfectionist trap, prediction-stuck, post-hoc prediction), with teacher_script, common_misconceptions, and recovery_moves. The summative rubric covers both D2 expectations on Ontario's 4-level scale.

instructional_balance.justification: Each lesson follows the Ontario minds_on / action / consolidation arc (12 + 25 + 13 = 50 min). Action structure 'whole_group_then_centres' (and 'individual' for capstone) gives floor-vs-desk balance. Three rotating stations of 7 min each. Differentiation tiers explicit per lesson.

clarity_communication.justification: Voice is consistent across lessons: Lucky and Mae anchor every minds-on; vocabulary introduced/reinforced is named explicitly; success_criteria use child-friendly 'I can' phrasing; teacher_script is concrete with quoted dialogue.

alignment.justification: Curriculum codes (D2.1, D2.2) mapped lesson-by-lesson via expectation_lesson_map. Each lesson's primary_expectations align to blueprint codes. Summative rubric covers both expectations with descriptors that match blueprint.curriculum_expectations text exactly. Image-text alignment validation passes.

appearance.justification: Composite generation passes 0 placeholders thanks to the smart_fallback composer + newly added LUCKY and MAYBE entries in _CHARACTER_CLIPART. Pre-grade drift check passed with 0 issues across all categories.
